title: Stress, path integration, and the entorhinal cortex
title_zh: 压力、路径积分与内嗅皮层
abstract: The stress induced release of glucocorticoids influences neural excitability and plasticity in the hippocampus. Surprisingly the entorhinal cortex (EC), an adjacent region, has received little attention in stress research, even though it is also rich in glucocorticoid receptors. Grid cells in the medial EC play a decisive role in path integration (PI). Interestingly, the EC is a brain region damaged very early in Alzheimer's disease (AD). Three recent studies investigated the associations between stress, cortisol and PI. In the first study chronic stress was associated with poorer PI. Acute stress induction impaired PI in the second study. In the third study cortisol administration impaired PI and reduced grid like representations in the EC as measured via fMRI. These findings have important implications. Future research on stress and spatial navigation should take the EC into account. Moreover, chronic stress is associated with an increased risk for AD. The findings suggest that the direct effect of cortisol on the EC may partially underly these clinical findings. Directions for future research are discussed.
abstract_zh: 压力诱导的糖皮质激素释放影响海马的神经兴奋性和可塑性。令人惊讶的是，邻近区域内嗅皮层（EC）在压力研究中几乎未受到关注，尽管它也富含糖皮质激素受体。内嗪皮层中间层的网格细胞在路径积分（PI）中起决定性作用。值得注意的是，内嗪皮层是阿尔茨海默病（AD）早期受损的脑区。最近的三项研究探讨了压力、皮质醇与PI之间的关联。第一项研究发现慢性压力与PI下降相关；第二项研究显示急性压力诱导会损害PI；第三项研究中，皮质醇给药导致PI受损，并通过fMRI测量显示EC中的网格样表征减少。这些发现具有重要意义。未来关于压力与空间导航的研究应考虑EC的作用；此外，慢性压力与AD风险增加相关。研究结果提示，皮质醇对EC的直接影响可能部分解释了这些临床发现。文中讨论了未来研究方向。
